0022600028.text: The Mavericks, who are 4-3 and ninth in the West after a loss in their most recent game, host the 1-7 Utah Jazz, who have lost six straight. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Max Christie (hip), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). The teams have not played each other yet this season, but they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and Dallas won their last meeting 138-120 in Dallas on January 17, 2026.
